name: symbioza
description: Run a GPU job under a hard dollar cap and collect the files it writes.

interface.shortDescription: Run GPU jobs under a spend cap
interface.longDescription: Symbioza runs your containerized GPU job on a rented cloud machine and hands back the files it writes, under a spending limit you set. Describe the job (a container image, the command and links to its input data) and Symbioza gives you a free estimate first, before you choose a budget: the price per hour of running, a total when there is evidence for one, what is still unknown, and whether your prepaid credit covers the budget you then pick. Nothing runs until you approve the submit with that budget. Symbioza sizes the machine, runs the job and reports its progress, then returns the output files with their SHA-256 hashes and time-limited download links, and the charge. The budget is a hard ceiling: it is checked before a machine is booked and again before every retry, and you are never billed more than it. Use it for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, batch inference and preprocessing. Credit is added on the Symbioza website.
